capabilities: Chat with vault notes through agent CLIs using @ file attachments
Edit selected note text with a word-level diff preview and apply step
Inspect expandable tool-activity summaries and file-edit diffs in chat
Run Obsidian-native vault actions like backlink inspection and link-aware file moves
Save selected chat text back into Markdown notes with undo
disambiguation: Not Claude-only despite the name; it also drives Codex, Cursor Agent, Grok Build, OpenCode, Pi, and DeepSeek Harness.
extras: Free and MIT-licensed, but includes no model subscription; provider subscriptions and API charges still apply. The README warns that the vault is not an OS security boundary and that provider approval modes (including YOLO and bash mode) should be reviewed carefully. Drafts are stored in .claudian/drafts/ inside the vault.
intentEvidence: Oh My Claudian began as a fork of Claudian by Yishen Tu.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to work with AI coding agents directly against vault notes.
